The socket commands of `admin_ops` find `admin.sock` by `-sockets`; local `recover` does not. `-rights` names the rights file; `-tls` the certificate-kit root (N1.6). `-raft` names the advertised Raft address, `-raft-bind` its listener; `-api` and `-api-bind` follow P/01.3-R007. `-bootstrap` starts the first member, `-join` names a member's API address, `-group-size` declares the size (P/01.3-R053, P/01.3-R054, P/01.3-R058, P/01.3-R059). `-door` follows R074; `-voters` lists voter ids/API addresses; `-tuning` R052; `-leader-wait` R063. `-max-value` is the row ceiling (P/01.3-R145, P/01.3-R145), `-max-body` the entity-body limit (R319); `-max-conns`, `-api-conns`, `-api-per-address` are the connection limits (R008). `-force` follows P/01.3-R054/P/01.3-R131; `-isolated` P/01.3-R020; `-upper` P/01.3-R020. `-peers` names the recovered membership: remaining ids with Raft/API addresses, including `-id`. `--from` is the immutable copy input; `-index-base` follows P/01.3-R141/P/01.3-R141. `-groups` belongs to `rights`.
